title: Binary search tree: find, insert and delete
summary: Maintain a BST of distinct keys. Insertion and deletion return the new subtree root, including when the root itself changes.
code: root = root.left if key < root.key else root.right
if root.left is None or root.right is None:
triggers: ordered keys stored in a branching search structure
remove a node that may have two children
prompts: Keep unique timestamps in a search tree as events arrive and expire.
Delete an internal key from an ordered index and keep all remaining keys searchable.
invariant: Every left descendant has a smaller key and every right descendant has a larger key.
mantra: Return the replacement root at every level.
pitfalls: After copying the inorder successor, delete its original node from the right subtree.

anchors.name: Delete Node in a BST
anchors.trick: The smallest node in the right subtree can replace a deleted key.

complexity.time: O(h) per operation for tree height h

mutations.explanation: Leaves a duplicate copy of the successor in the right subtree.

test: return inorder(node.left) + [node.key] + inorder(node.right) if node else []
